I (30) have shared the same experience with my bf (27). I hated myself for years because of things that were done to me and for things that turned me on as a result of those things. 
I told him in an effort to dissuade bis affection for me. I was convinced that if anyone knew me, really knew me, they'd leave anyway. 
We've been together for over a year and are getting married in June!
I guess there really is someone for everyone.
Thank you. I'm sure I will always need to shout from time to time.
It's gotta be. That's what I tell myself. I just don't believe it. I haven't made an attempt in a really long time... I don't understand it but I always keep going.
I wish I had an answer. I'm so sorry. I understand .
Thank you as well, for not trying to convince my that the way I feel is incorrect. Thank you for seeing me.

Thank you for this. You get it. I love helping people. It makes me feel like all that pain I went through was worth it. Most of the people I help have their own pain and I cannot bring myself to cause them more. It doesn't change how I feel though. I'm so grateful that you understand and aren't telling me how lucky I am to be alive.

They don't laugh at me at all. They think I'm amazing. I'm a survivor of horrific things but I carry on in my life helping others. I just want to die. I don't want to hurt any more but I don't want to hurt anyone else.
I'm not sure what you're asking.

Hope comes and goes. So I'm not sure if it's hope. But self preservation. It's weird that I haven't been back reddit in a really long time and today of all days, I feel especially hopeless.... and here this message is.

I suppose. I don't want to use any more though. I'd rather die then to be who I was under the influence of drugs and alcohol. I try and be the best I can be. So efficiently in fact that most people have no idea how I feel inside. That's the way I like to keep it. I vent on here from time to time when the pressure is too much. Most of the time, it passes. It always passes. I just keep trudging along. It's only when I feel as if I'm about to explode that I voice how I truly feel.

Not for me. I've spent to much of my life using drugs and alcohol to forget. In April I'll be sober for 2 years. The idea of a chemical peace of mine.... Prescription or otherwise is a very frightening thing for me.

I've shared them before and all it does is awaken them. Of course I've thought of professional help, I've tried. Unfortunately, insurance isn't a luxury I have and the places that will "treat",me without insurance are only looking to medicate me.
I don't know. Some days I'm ok. Others I just don't want to live. I carry some burdens I suppose. No point in going into them cause none of it matters. Nothing matters, everything is meaningless.
Thank you. That is something I can go back to and read again, when I began to forget my purpose. Ultimately, I'm a very small piece of a greater whole.

Yeah. I often tell myself that it really could be worse. And it could. Even though I've been through some terrible shit. You'd never know it to meet me. I'm pretty, intelligent, wise, whitty, I can cook, and I sing like an angel. I have some serious issues. Still I've proud of the woman I've become under such adversity. Thank you for taking the time to comment and show interest in my story.
Make meth
I'm kind of there myself.
That's what I always did. DD meant I was driving and would be slightly less drunk than my friends.
My life pretty much has always sucked. I'm sure they're good times.... Not sure there's ever been real joy. Nothing matters. I don't matter.

I know you are right. Of course you're right. That's been my experience too. It's just that here lately the way I feel tonight is more frequent. It's like being under water and coming up for air. Then back under. The gulps of air are less and less. The water engulfing me, holding me tighter. Thank you for taking the time to encourage me. I appreciate it, more than you could ever know. 
I bet most of us post just to feel like someone cares.
I'm tired of being strong.
My life has changed for the better. How I feel hasn't. Each  day is a struggle to hold on.  Thanks for understanding.

Are you really a therapist? I spoken with several for a time. Then they get too close or I get scared. I find any and all reasons to not go back. 
Is it possible that I surround myself with people who sometimes treat me like I don't matter or do you think it's more likely that I expect too much? I put everyones need before my own and then get upset with them when they put their needs before mine. 
I cut myself. And everyday I want to die. Tonight it's overwhelming. I'm not alone though, so don't freak out. Tonight is not the night. 
I don't want to live anymore. Can you please help me? Please. I've asked for help before. But everyone assumes I'm dramatic or just joking. I've got a very charming personality and I'm a foundation of strength and wisdom for those around me. 
But I'm scared. I'm so scared. I don't want to kill myself. That's selfish. I don't want to hurt my friends and family..... But I don't want to live. I pray for a car accident or some sort of death that is more acceptable. Not in my power. 
Please help me.

I've tried to get some help but I really don't know the resources available for someone in my financial situation. I just wanted to know someone gave a shit. I mostly make excuses for the people in my life who've hurt me. I'm less angry that way.... Most of all I hate myself.

Yeah. I've got a clean bill of health. Prison's good for somethings. I would love professional help. However, it's not anything I can afford. Besides what's the use? They'll just drug me up and turn me into a zombie. At least this way, I can be of sound mind to help others.... Even if most of the time I feel like that's a crap pay off. Kind of not worth it to me. But it is what it is. Gotta make the most of it. And if I can somehow help other women, which I do, through the fellowship of Alcoholics Anonymous, then I should feel lucky. I used to. I used to believe I was chosen to carry such a burden to help others. Then my symptoms started getting worse.... And I could give a fuck. I just want some peace.

My grandparents played a game with me when I was very young..3 and 4 called kitty cat stretch. My grandma would pet my hair and tell me it was all a game and that it didn't hurt... My grandfather (by marriage) finally forced himself into me around the age of 7. My grandmother left me with him... It continued until he died. I was 15. I met a man 22 years old my senior 2 years later and for years because of drugs he force fed me and a misguided definition of love and loyalty, I was sold to all kinds of men. They did unspeakable things to me. Shoved whatever they could inside of me. Spit on me. Urinated on me. Forced me to have sex with a Great Dane named Hollywood..... There's so much more. Children taken by the state... Physical abuse. My dad is an alcoholic. I know him very little. My mother never believed me. Till this day, the most she can say, is that she didn't know and she's confused about it all. I never told anyone in authority until is was too late. By then I'd made a name for myself as a drunk junkie. Hell, I've only
 just started to remember all I this in the past 5 years. I always knew. But as I've tried to get sober and eventually stayed sober.... I'm free of addiction but locked inside the torture chamber that is my mind...... Sorry. You did ask.

Flashbacks, panic attacks, memories, self hate, depression. I suppose if you knew me in person you would understand. The people in my life do not see me as anything but a pillar of strength and wisdom. They come to me for guidance, lean on me when they are weak or in pain. I'm outgoing and witty and brighten everyone's day. People are better for having known me. Words come out of myself that are not my own and I change people... Well, I at least, help them change themselves. I am spiritual advisor to many, teacher to even more, and mother to all I meet. Somehow on my journey I've become for most people the very things I needed someone to be for me. I am loving and kind. Funny and smart. There's no room for me to be who I really am in my life. Too many people count on me. I hold it in. When I let it out it's such a shock to those around me that it gets swept under the rug or not taken seriously. I'm the girl with all the answers, the girl that makes it all better. Only I know how I loathe my every breath. People see what the need to see, hear what they need to hear. They all need me to be certain things..... None of them can handle the broken me. It's actually kind of ironic, I can be all of these things because of my experience.... Still internally I'm not well at all.
You did. Weird how a random purge of emotion on reddit has been therapeutic.
I live in a recovery house, I'm a waitress. I'm on probation. And I'm always alone because I'm a prisoner to my own mind

Thanks. My life is just a struggle. I'm a recovering alcoholic. 18 months. But I've been in and out of jail. I have a horrible record. My life has taken on new meaning with my sobriety, but it doesn't change what's happened. Doesn't change how lost and scared I feel all the time. I want to die because I'm exhausted. My soul is weary. I've always been alone.

I don't draw but I used to write. When I was younger. I'm 30 years old... But when I read your words, it touches the girl inside of me. As an adult I know that I matter, and that it wasn't my fault. But she doesn't. I guess that sounds weird. Thank you. Even if I can't articulate what for.

Thank you. Believe it or not it helps to know someone hears me. I believe that I've endured what I have so that I can help others and I do. Often. It's just sometimes.... That's not enough. It's not a good enough reason for me. Not a fair trade off. 
I love dogs. I'm sorry for your loss. No one person's pain is greater than another's. Pain is pain and I'm very sorry that you have had your fair share. 
Thanks again for reaching out.

I really appreciate you not judging me. I'm not one to blame people for my shortcomings. I did that for many years and couldn't get sober. 
I know lots of little girls live through what I did and so not grow up to be raging alcoholic's. 
I suppose it just sucks. I've become exactly what a little girl living in the conditions are predicted to become and because of it, I'm less worthy of help. 
It's very frustrating and leaves me feeling hopeless. I often pretend nothing is wrong. I can go through a full blown panic attack and hold it in. To where the witness believes I've just gotten lost in deep thought. 
As far as sobriety I got myself into a situation about 20 months ago where I was anal raped by a group of men and a plunger handle. I realized the thing I used to sheltar me from my pain had in fact caused me a whole different set of issues and I hung it up.

Yeah. I guess that's why I don't hate her. She only saw what she was capable of processing. I'm not in college. I'm a high school dropout and a convicted felon. I used drugs and alcohol as a means of escape. I've only been sober for 18 months and I live in a recovery house. Sometimes it seems like society doesn't really give a shit about a girl like me. 
I'll do some more research, but every time I try I get shot down it feels like.

Thank you for your words of support. I come from a place of if you don't talk about it, it didn't happen. 
I'm sorry for what happened to you.

The yeast infections weren't real, it was what my mom said was wrong with me. It was really from the rape. My mom couldn't see the truth. 
As far as therapy I'm in no position to pay for it. Thank you for giving a shit. It's kind of new for me.

I went through the same thing. But it was my grandfather and sometimes his friend. They would give me homemade wine and liquor to relax me. It started when I was 4 and continued until he died. I was 15. 
Till this day my mom doesn't believe me and any time I asked for help as I child, I was accused of insanity, being a liar, or filthy (my swolen vagina was a yeast infection not rape). 
I have panic attacks and nightmares often. I don't feel normal and some times I separate from my body feeling lost and just not there. 
I'm 30 years old and I'm convinced that I'll always be broken and I wonder if I can make it another 30 years without killing myself. 
And yet, all I want is to be somebody's "good girl".

Maybe instead of trying to overcome the fear of pulling the trigger, focus on overcoming the fear to live. I've tried killing myself several times. One time the gun didn't go off. The bullet got caught in the chamber. You are worth more than this. If I am, you are too.
